AboutText.TITLE: About Me
AboutText.BODY1: I'm Facundo, a 19-year-old developer tech enthusiast. I've been programming since I was 12, which has given me a strong foundation to specialize in frontend development with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, complemented by knowledge in Node.js and PostgreSQL.
AboutText.BODY2: My most notable project is GymPro, a complete management system for gyms that I developed from scratch. It includes member administration, personalized workout routines, membership control, and an integrated payment gateway for both free and paid plans.
AboutText.BODY3: I'm looking for a job opportunity as a developer to apply my skills in a professional environment. I speak both Spanish and English, which allows me to collaborate with international teams and access technical documentation without barriers.
AboutText.BODY4: On my GitHub, you'll find more projects that reflect my self-taught journey and continuous growth.

g2i.tasks: Job as an AI Trainer focused on Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), I contributed to the development of language models by evaluating, ranking, and refining AI-generated responses.
